title: Randomised Trials for Therapists — Randomisation, Blinding and Real-World Fit

hook.en: A randomised trial is the best tool we have for asking "does it work?", but in physiotherapy you cannot blind the therapist or the patient to an exercise class. Learn what randomisation really protects, what blinding problems mean and why a trial can be perfect and still not fit your clinic.
hook.ur: Randomised trial "kya kaam karta hai?" poochhne ka hamare paas behtareen aala hai, lekin physiotherapy mein aap exercise class mein therapist ya mareez ko blind nahi kar sakte. Seekhein ke randomisation asal mein kis cheez se bachati hai, blinding ke masail ka kya matlab hai aur trial mukammal ho kar bhi aap ke clinic ke liye kyun munasib nahi ho sakta.

goal.en: By the end, you'll explain what random allocation and concealment protect against, say which people can be blinded in a physiotherapy trial, define intention-to-treat, and tell a pragmatic from an explanatory trial.
goal.ur: End tak aap samjhayenge ke random allocation aur concealment kis se bachate hain, batayenge physiotherapy trial mein kin logon ko blind kiya ja sakta hai, intention-to-treat ki tareef karenge, aur pragmatic ko explanatory trial se alag karenge.

text.en: **Randomisation** gives each patient an equal chance of getting either treatment, so the groups should be alike in everything, including things nobody measured. **Concealment** hides the upcoming group from the person enrolling, so they cannot steer a patient to a group. **Blinding** hides the treatment from those who might be influenced: the patient, the therapist or the assessor. In physiotherapy, patients and therapists often cannot be blinded, so blinding the **assessor** matters most.
text.ur: **Randomisation** har mareez ko dono ilajon mein se ek milne ka barabar moqa deti hai, isliye groups har cheez mein milte-julte hone chahiyein, un cheezon mein bhi jo kisi ne nahi naapi. **Concealment** agle group ko enroll karne wale se chhupata hai, taake woh mareez ko kisi group ki taraf na bhej sake. **Blinding** ilaaj ko un se chhupati hai jo mutasir ho sakte hain: mareez, therapist ya assessor. Physiotherapy mein mareez aur therapist aksar blind nahi ho sakte, isliye **assessor** ko blind karna sab se ahem hai.

text.en: Think of **picking teams in the playground by drawing lots**. If the captain picks, the strong players end up on one team. If lots are drawn from a bag the captain cannot see into, the teams are fair. Randomisation is the drawing, concealment is the opaque bag, and blinding is the referee who does not know which team is which.
text.ur: **Maidan mein parchi nikal kar teamein chunna** sochein. Agar captain chune to mazboot khiladi ek team mein ho jate hain. Agar parchiyan aise thaile se nikalen jis mein captain dekh na sake to teamein munsifana hoti hain. Randomisation parchi nikalna hai, concealment dhundla thaila hai, aur blinding woh referee hai jo nahi jaanta kaun si team kaun si hai.

title.en: Who can be blinded in a physiotherapy trial?
title.ur: Physiotherapy trial mein kise blind kiya ja sakta hai?

rows.en: Often not; patients know if they are exercising or being treated by hand
rows.ur: Aksar nahi; mareez jaante hain woh exercise kar rahe hain ya haath se ilaaj ho raha hai

rows.en: Use a credible comparison, measure expectation and report the limit honestly
rows.ur: Mo'tabar comparison istemal karein, umeed naapein aur had imaandari se report karein

rows.en: Use trained, equally enthusiastic therapists and standard instructions
rows.ur: Trained, barabar josheelay therapists aur standard hidayat istemal karein

rows.en: Usually yes, if a different person measures
rows.ur: Aam taur par haan, agar koi aur naape

rows.en: Use a masked assessor and ask patients not to reveal their group
rows.ur: Masked assessor rakhein aur mareezon se kahein group na batayein

rows.en: Analyse with group codes before unmasking
rows.ur: Unmasking se pehle group codes ke saath tajziya karein

question.en: A trial of manual therapy versus exercise has the treating therapist also measure range of motion at follow-up. What is the main concern?
question.ur: Manual therapy bamuqabil exercise ke trial mein ilaaj karne wala therapist hi follow-up par range of motion naapta hai. Sab se badi fikr kya hai?

text.en: Detection bias, because the measurer knows the group and may measure in favour of the treatment
text.ur: Detection bias, kyunke naapne wale ko group maloom hai aur woh ilaaj ke haq mein naap sakta hai

feedback.en: Yes — a masked, independent assessor avoids this.
feedback.ur: Haan — masked, azaad assessor is se bachata hai.

text.en: Selection bias, because patients were randomised
text.ur: Selection bias, kyunke mareez randomise kiye gaye

feedback.ur: Randomisation selection bias kam karti hai.

text.en: No concern, because therapists are experts
text.ur: Koi fikr nahi, kyunke therapists maahir hain

feedback.en: Expertise does not remove unconscious bias.
feedback.ur: Maharat ghair shuoori bias ko khatam nahi karti.

text.ur: Yeh trial ko bara banata hai

text.en: It stops the person enrolling from steering patients into a group, which would undo the benefit of randomisation
text.ur: Yeh enroll karne wale ko mareez ek group mein bhejne se rokta hai, jo randomisation ka faida khatam kar deta

feedback.en: Yes — knowing the next allocation lets people cherry-pick.
feedback.ur: Haan — agla allocation jaan kar log chun-chun kar bhej sakte hain.

text.ur: Yeh mareezon ko blind karta hai

feedback.en: Concealment is before allocation; blinding is after.
feedback.ur: Concealment allocation se pehle hai; blinding baad mein.

question.en: In an intention-to-treat analysis, patients are analysed according to what?
question.ur: Intention-to-treat tajziye mein mareezon ka tajziya kis ke mutabiq hota hai?

text.en: Only those who completed all sessions
text.ur: Sirf jinhon ne tamam sessions mukammal kiye

feedback.ur: Yeh sirf mukammal karne walon ka tajziya hai.

text.en: Only the treatment they actually received
text.ur: Sirf jo ilaaj unhein asal mein mila

feedback.en: That is per-protocol and can introduce bias.
feedback.ur: Yeh per-protocol hai aur bias la sakta hai.

text.en: The group they were randomised to, whether or not they completed or followed the treatment
text.ur: Us group ke mutabiq jis mein woh randomise hue, chahe unhon ne ilaaj mukammal ya follow kiya ho ya nahi

feedback.en: Yes — it keeps the benefit of randomisation and mirrors real-world adherence.
feedback.ur: Haan — yeh randomisation ka faida rakhta hai aur haqeeqi duniya ki adherence ko dikhata hai.

text.en: **Calling a trial "randomised" without checking how.** Alternating patients, using the day of the week or letting the therapist choose is not random. Look for a described method (a computer list, shuffled sealed envelopes) and for concealment. Also, do not forget that a trial can be well randomised and still weak if many drop out or assessors are not masked.
text.ur: **Trial ko "randomised" keh dena bina dekhe ke kaise.** Mareezon ko bari bari dena, hafte ka din istemal karna ya therapist ko chunne dena random nahi. Bayan shuda tareeqa (computer list, phente hue sealed envelopes) aur concealment dekhein. Yeh bhi na bhoolein ke trial achhi randomisation ke baad bhi kamzor ho sakta hai agar bohat se chhor jayein ya assessors masked na hon.

text.en: **Ask whether this trial looks like your clinic.** A pragmatic trial tests a treatment in everyday conditions, with typical patients and flexible delivery. An explanatory trial tests it under ideal conditions, with selected patients and strict protocols. For your Tuesday-afternoon patient, a pragmatic result is usually closer to what you can expect.
text.ur: **Poochhein ke yeh trial aap ke clinic jaisa hai ya nahi.** Pragmatic trial ilaaj ko roz-marra halaat mein, aam mareezon aur lachakdar tareeqe se aazmata hai. Explanatory trial ise mukammal halaat mein, chunindah mareezon aur sakht protocol ke saath aazmata hai. Aap ke mangal ki dopahar ke mareez ke liye pragmatic nateeja aksar us ke zyada qareeb hota hai jo aap ummeed kar sakte hain.

question.en: If patients cannot be blinded, is every physiotherapy trial doomed?
question.ur: Agar mareez blind nahi ho sakte to kya har physiotherapy trial nakam hai?

answer.en: No. Blinding the assessor, using objective outcomes where possible, reporting expectations, and using credible comparison treatments all reduce the problem. The key is to be honest about it, to interpret self-reported outcomes such as pain with extra caution, and not to dismiss the whole trial because of one limit.
answer.ur: Nahi. Assessor ko blind karna, mumkin ho to objective outcomes istemal karna, umeedon ki report dena aur mo'tabar comparison ilaaj istemal karna masla kam karte hain. Aham baat is par imaandar hona hai, dard jaise khud-report kiye outcomes ko mazeed ehtiyat se parhna, aur ek had ki wajah se poore trial ko radd na karna.

beats.patient: A trial compares an eight-week exercise class with usual care for knee osteoarthritis. 120 patients were randomised, 30 in the exercise group never attended. The authors analyse only the 60 who finished the class.
beats.assessment: This is a per-protocol analysis. It ignores the 30 who did not attend and may overestimate the benefit.
beats.treatment: A better analysis would include everyone according to their randomised group (intention-to-treat), and report how many attended, with a separate analysis of those who did.
beats.reassess: The intention-to-treat result shows what you would see in practice, where not everyone attends.

text.en: **Safety needs its own attention.** Trials are often too small or short to find rare harms. Check how adverse events were recorded and reported, not just whether the treatment worked. If a trial does not mention harms, treat that as missing information, not as proof of safety.
text.ur: **Safety ko alag tawajjo chahiye.** Trials aksar nadir nuqsan dhoondhne ke liye bohat chhote ya mukhtasar hote hain. Dekhein ke adverse events kaise record aur report hue, sirf yeh nahi ke ilaaj kaam kiya. Agar trial nuqsan ka zikr na kare to isay missing information samjhein, safety ka saboot nahi.

text.en: Schulz and Grimes explained that blinding reduces bias after allocation, while allocation concealment prevents selection bias before allocation, and that trials lacking adequate concealment or blinding tend to exaggerate treatment effects. The CONSORT extension for pragmatic trials describes how trials that test treatments in everyday conditions should report their eligibility, flexibility of delivery and outcomes relevant to decision makers.
text.ur: Schulz aur Grimes ne samjhaya ke blinding allocation ke baad bias kam karti hai, jabke allocation concealment allocation se pehle selection bias rokti hai, aur jin trials mein kaafi concealment ya blinding nahi hoti woh ilaaj ke asar ko barha kar dikhate hain. Pragmatic trials ke liye CONSORT extension batata hai ke jo trials ilaaj ko roz-marra halaat mein aazmate hain unhein apni eligibility, delivery ki lachak aur faisla saazon ke liye ahem nateejon ki report kaise deni chahiye.

text.en: **Random, Conceal, Blind the assessor, Intention-to-treat.** The four protections of a good trial.
text.ur: **Random, Conceal, Assessor ko blind, Intention-to-treat.** Achhe trial ki chaar hifazatein.

summary.en: Randomisation balances groups, concealment protects the allocation, and blinding the assessor matters most in physiotherapy trials.
summary.ur: Randomisation groups ko mutawazin karti hai, concealment allocation ko mehfooz rakhti hai, aur physiotherapy trials mein assessor ko blind karna sab se ahem hai.

summary.en: Intention-to-treat analysis keeps people in their randomised group and shows what happens in practice.
summary.ur: Intention-to-treat tajziya logon ko unke randomised group mein rakhta hai aur dikhata hai ke amal mein kya hota hai.

summary.en: Pragmatic trials fit everyday clinics better than explanatory trials; check harms and generalisability.
summary.ur: Pragmatic trials roz-marra clinics mein explanatory trials se behtar fit hote hain; nuqsan aur generalisability jaanchein.

front.ur: Allocation concealment kis se bachati hai?

back.en: Selection bias before the patient is assigned.
back.ur: Mareez tay hone se pehle selection bias.

front.en: Who is most important to blind in a physiotherapy trial?
front.ur: Physiotherapy trial mein kise blind karna sab se ahem hai?

back.en: Analysing patients in the group they were randomised to.
back.ur: Mareezon ka tajziya us group mein jis mein woh randomise hue.

back.en: One that tests a treatment in everyday, real-world conditions.
back.ur: Jo ilaaj ko roz-marra, haqeeqi duniya ke halaat mein aazmaye.

note.ur: Chhe sawalon ki jaanch, randomisation aur masking samet.
